deadline.value: Priority date December 1, 2026; later applications are reviewed until the class fills, but only those in by December 1 are guaranteed review.
deadline.quote: The priority date for Fall 2027 applications is December 1, 2026. However, applications submitted after this date will continue to be reviewed until the class is filled.

also.quote: Only applications submitted before December 1 are guaranteed to be reviewed.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE is not required; you may submit scores if they help.
gre_subject.quote: No, we do not require GRE General or Subject scores. This pertains to both domestic and international applications. | If you feel that your GRE scores will bolster your application, you may submit the scores.

supervisor.value: You can contact faculty, but no agreement with a professor is needed to apply or be admitted.
supervisor.quote: There is absolutely no requirement to have an agreement with a specific faculty member in order to apply and be admitted

funding.value: Stipend $32,100 a year plus tuition and mandatory fees, guaranteed for 5 years in good standing (subject to funding availability), for domestic and international students.
funding.quote: Support is guaranteed for 5 years for students maintaining good academic standing and funding availability.

also.quote: Assistantship stipends are $32,100 for twelve months. In addition, tuition and mandatory fees are paid for PhD students in good standing, both domestic and international, for at least 5 years of graduate study and subject to availability of funds.

entry_route.value: A BA/BS (or MS) in chemistry or a closely related field is expected; all students enter the PhD program.
entry_route.quote: A B.A., B.S., M.S., or equivalent degree in chemistry or a degree in a closely related field with appropriate chemistry coursework is expected.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required; you may submit scores, with no disadvantage if you don't.
gre_general.quote: No, we do not require GRE General or Subject scores. This pertains to both domestic and international applications. | If you feel that your GRE scores will bolster your application, you may submit the scores.

toefl_min.value: The department expects TOEFL iBT 100+ with speaking 23+ (26+ preferred), above the university minimum.
toefl_min.quote: For international students, we expect TOEFL scores of at least 100 with a speaking of at least 23, or IELTS of 7.0+, with a speaking of at least 7.0.

ielts_min.value: The department expects IELTS 7.0+ with speaking 7.0+ (8.0 preferred).
ielts_min.quote: For international students, we expect TOEFL scores of at least 100 with a speaking of at least 23, or IELTS of 7.0+, with a speaking of at least 7.0.

fee_waiver.value: The department waives the fee for domestic students only.
fee_waiver.quote: Application Fee Waived for Domestic Students!

notes: Spring admission only case by case. Offers mostly by mid-February; response due April 15, 2027.
